source: Full audit of resources/[tarboro]/* on disk, diffed against server.cfg's ensure list, cross-checked against build memory. Re-run this diff any time a resource is added or removed to catch drift immediately. First 2026-08-12 pass re-read every file touched in the prior ~4h (no git in this repo, diffed by mtime) to catch a batch of undocumented work: the tarboro-needs eat/drink fix, the new injuries item system, Trap Line, and the clothing-store fix. A same-day follow-up pass caught a second, later batch: the new grow-op placeables/watering/air-drop systems, and the Mail-vs-Messages channel-routing fix.
caveat: Every resource below, including ones marked "good", has never been run by a real connected player. "good" means the build has a real narrative record and passed a boot test (all 60 running resources start cleanly with zero errors) — not that anyone has clicked the prompt, opened the menu, or walked the flow in-game. Status values: crit = not running at all, warn = thin or zero documentation, good = documented. Resources with a checks list can be marked tested behavior-by-behavior — a resource only shows fully tested once every one of its checks is checked.

items.name: tarboro-drugs
items.desc: 5-tier legal weed economy (cash payout), acid (replaces meth), coke, and crack verticals; baggie-gated packaging; a grow-op placeables layer (portable acid labs, sprinklers, watering can); random reachability-validated air drops.
items.note: MAJOR BUG FOUND+FIXED 2026-08-10 — the entire 5-tier weed/acid item rework had never actually been merged into ox_inventory's real item registry, so none of those items could be granted at all. Fixed: 16 missing items added, 5 stale old-strain items removed, item count went 308→319 exactly matching the math. Real coords for the Vinewood Hills (crimson) forage area also walked in and swapped in for the old placeholders. EXPANDED 2026-08-12 — three new subsystems: (1) Placeables — acid_lab_kit ($4500, worse batch/purity than every fixed station on purpose so it can't obsolete them) and sprinkler ($220), placeable only on owned property, reusing tarboro-property's ghost-placer via a cross-resource StartPlacement() export rather than building a second placement UI. (2) Watering — watering_can ($45) + sprinklers accelerate grow time (capped total boost per plant) but a plant can never die or stall from neglect by design. (3) Air drops — replaces the old fixed CokeDropZones; one generic system for both chem_precursor and coke_brick_raw, candidates ring-picked around a random online player and validated by a real client (ground/water/interior checks) before the crate exists, first-come-first-served. ACID VERTICAL REWORKED 2026-08-12 — (a) blotter paper is now a real recipe input, not flavour: acid_raw + paper + baggie -> tabs, matching how LSD is actually dosed (paper $8 at the 24/7). (b) Tabs can be made TWO ways — at a bagging station (2s) or in hand anywhere by using Blotter Paper (6s, slower on purpose so the station still has a reason to exist); both fire the SAME server recipe so they can't drift apart or be played against each other. (c) Tabs of Acid is now consumable from the inventory context menu — a ~2min trip cycling four stock GTA timecycles with drunk-cam wobble, which always tears down on death/respawn/resource-stop so nobody can get stuck tripping. (d) PURITY NOW AFFECTS VALUE, not just volume: a clean cook at a station with real glassware returns a share of its output as high-grade (acid_raw_pure -> acid_packaged_pure, $340 vs the standard $200). Tier 2 = 40% high grade, Tier 3 = 100%, portable lab = never (its 0.85 multiplier sits below the threshold by design). Previously the skill check and station tier only scaled the COUNT, so a flawless Superlab cook and a botched RV cook sold for exactly the same price. The yield maths is shared by both cook paths on purpose — a discrepancy there would be an exploit (cook wherever pays better), not just a bug. (e) The three cook stations finally have map blips; they were the one part of any vertical you had to already know the coordinates of to find.

items.note: The one system with the deepest verification on this list — its icon-editing drag interactions were validated in a real disposable browser test harness, though it's still never run inside the actual game client. FIXED 2026-08-11 — mail buttons (Set GPS on midgame nudges, Start Selling on the drug Trap Line) used to be one-shot: the DB column got blanked after a single press, so any button meant to be pressed more than once silently died forever after the first use. Buttons are now repeatable; the old one-shot handler still exists for any future genuinely single-use button, it's just not called by these. FIXED 2026-08-12 — Mail and Messages used to duplicate every system text: Messages rendered EVERY row from the mail pipeline as a synthetic thread, so the same action button (Trap Line, midgame nudges) appeared in both apps at once. Fixed with a new `channel` column on player_mails ('mail' vs 'sms', existing rows auto-backfilled by detecting system-style buttons) and a new sendTextMessage() export that routes to 'sms' only; both real call sites (tarboro-drugs' Trap Line, tarboro-midgame's nudges) were switched to it. Mail now filters out channel==='sms', Messages filters TO channel==='sms' — each row lives in exactly one app. One loose end: a comment block in apps.js above the Messages code still describes the old pre-fix behavior; harmless, just stale documentation next to the corrected code.
